headline: CHIの活性部位に、phloretinの8通りの姿勢が見えた
subhead: 非対称単位の8分子がphloretinの異なる姿勢を保ち、環化に向かう経路を示唆する

summary.question: カルコン異性化酵素（CHI）は、基質の形の組み替えにタンパク質の動きを使うのかが、問われ続けていた。
summary.approach: MtCHI-Iの結晶に基質アナログphloretinを浸漬して、2.0 Åの結晶構造を解き、変異体と速度論で確かめた。
summary.result: 非対称単位の8分子でphloretinの姿勢が異なり、環化に関わる(Ph)2′O–C3間の距離は3.98〜3.09 Åだった。
summary.learned: CHIは動的な構造の集まりとして働き、基質の組み替えを助けると考えられる。phloretinは競合阻害剤でもある。
summary.open: 先行モデルは2型CHIによるが、本研究が調べたのは1型CHIだけという限界がある。

question.quote: A persistent question has been whether the enzyme uses protein dynamics to facilitate conformational rearrangements of substrates within the active site.

approach.quote: Finally, the MtCHI‐I crystals were soaked for 1 week in the reservoir solution also containing 20‐mM phloretin.
approach.section: Protein Crystallography, Structure Determination, and Analysis

approach.quote: CHI from Medicago truncatula was crystallized with phloretin, a flexible substrate analogue that cannot undergo cyclization, and solved to 2.0‐Å resolution.

result.quote: The crystal structure possesses eight protein molecules per asymmetric unit, revealing different active site conformations that accommodate different bound conformers of phloretin.
In the pose called “mol. D,” the phloretin (Ph)2′O‐(Ph)C3 interatomic distance is 3.98 Å
result.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

result.quote: which measures the smallest interatomic distance between (Ph)2′O‐(Ph)C3, of 3.09 Å
result.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

learned.quote: Overall, this work supports a catalytic model in which the CHI enzyme operates as a dynamic ensemble of structures necessary to facilitate catalytic substrate rearrangements.
A double reciprocal Lineweaver–Burk plot confirms that phloretin inhibits MtCHI‐I through a competitive mechanism
learned.section: Phloretin Is a Competitive Enzyme Inhibitor of MtCHI-I

open.quote: One notable limitation of the present work is that previous models of CHI, such as the one used by Hur and colleagues, were based upon evidence from a Type‐2 CHI, whereas the present work examines only a Type‐1 CHI

highlights.text: 環化から最も遠いmol. Dではphloretinの(Ph)2′O–C3間が3.98 Å、最も近いmol. Bでは3.09 Åになる。mol. Bでは、触媒Arg（R37）のグアニジノ基が3つの水素結合を作る。

evidence.quote: The phloretin conformation that best approximates the near attack, cyclization‐productive conformer occurs in mol. B, which measures the smallest interatomic distance between (Ph)2′O‐(Ph)C3, of 3.09 Å
evidence.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

evidence.quote: Here, three critical H‐bond interactions are provided by the guanidinium of R37 when they are at their closest to phloretin
evidence.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

highlights.text: R37のNη2とphloretinの2′Oの水素結合は、観察されたすべての姿勢で保たれる。phloretinのA環の位置は、T49・S193・Y107の側鎖がほぼ一定に保つ。

evidence.quote: The most critical of these may be the enzyme‐substrate H‐bond that occurs between (R37)Nƞ2 and (Ph)2′O, which is maintained through all observed poses.
evidence.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

evidence.quote: the active site position and orientation of the A ring of phloretin are very consistently maintained by three amino acid sidechains
evidence.section: Crystallographic Insights Into the Catalytic Plasticity of CHI

highlights.text: phloretinはMtCHI-Iの競合阻害剤で、Kiは32 ± 4 μMだった。DSFで求めたKd（26 ± 1 μM）とほぼ合い、T49A・R37K・S193Aの変異体では結合が弱まった。

evidence.quote: From the enzyme inhibition experiments, the inhibitory constant, Ki value, averaged from the three inhibitor concentrations, is calculated to be 32 ± 4 μM.
evidence.section: Phloretin Is a Competitive Enzyme Inhibitor of MtCHI-I

evidence.quote: These results confirm that the H‐bonds between phloretin and the sidechain atoms of Ser193, Arg37, and Thr49, observed in the MtCHI‐I‐phloretin crystal structure, are also important for solution binding.
evidence.section: Solution Studies of Phloretin Binding Within the MtCHI-I Active Site

lab_notes.expression: pET-21bから大腸菌BL21 DE3-pRILで発現させ、20 °Cで一晩誘導した。
lab_notes.construct: Hisタグ付きで精製し、トロンビンでタグを切った。
lab_notes.purification: Ni-NTA、再度のNiカラム（素通り画分）に続き、結晶化用にResource Q陰イオン交換とSuperdex 200ゲルろ過で精製した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 30 mg/mLで吊り滴蒸気拡散により結晶化し、20 mM phloretinを含む母液に1週間浸漬した。
lab_notes.data_collection: ALSのBL 8.2.1/8.2.2で100 Kで測定した。結晶は双晶と回転擬対称を示し、双晶演算子を使って精密化した。

evidence.quote: A pET‐21b protein expression plasmid containing the gene for M. truncatula , MtCHI‐I (UniProt: B7FJK3), was transformed into BL21 DE3‐pRIL cells (Agilent Technologies).
Cells were grown in Terrific Broth (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and induced overnight at 20°C.
The His tag was cleaved at 4°C by bovine thrombin (EMD Millipore Corp.)
MtCHI‐I was first purified by Ni‐affinity chromatography as described above, then further purified by FPLC on a resource Q anion exchange column (Cytiva).
evidence.section: Protein Crystallography, Structure Determination, and Analysis

evidence.quote: Finally, the MtCHI‐I crystals were soaked for 1 week in the reservoir solution also containing 20‐mM phloretin.
evidence.section: Protein Crystallography, Structure Determination, and Analysis

editor_notes: 構造は38KF（phloretin複合体、2.0 Å）。同じMtCHI-Iのnaringenin（産物）複合体は先行研究（Burke 2019）で既出で、UniProt B7FJK3 の既存PDB も1件あり初構造ではない。論文は結論で「first structural evidence of the dynamic process of chalcone ring closure」と書くが、基質アナログの結晶構造から経路を推定しているため、記事では「示唆」「考えられる」にとどめた。phloretinはアナログでアルケンがなく環化しない点に注意。legend_labels は render 前のため一旦1つだけ設定。
